Verifier._lzReceive() at line 440: validates require(origin.srcEid == $.hubEid, InvalidHubSource(origin.srcEid)) - only accepts messages from the configured Hub endpoint.

The withdraw() function at lines 271-291 handles NATIVE_TOKEN withdrawals correctly: (1) _debitCombinedNativeBalance or _debitNativeBalance validates user has sufficient balance, (2) call{value: amount} transfers exact requested amount. The receive() function at lines 619-626 credits msg.value to user's nativeBalances. For internal operations, _applyNativeFeeRefund() at lines 592-598 ensures unused native fees are credited back to user's balance.

evidence.phase1_static: All 5 attack vectors analyzed. Input Validation: Dual condition ensures both msg.sender and flag. State Transition: Flag set/clear is atomic within enableSelfCall modifier. Resource Exhaustion: N/A - no loops. Error Handling: Clear error types for each failure mode. Concurrency: Transient storage is transaction-scoped, preventing cross-transaction attacks. The pattern effectively prevents external reentrancy.
evidence.phase2_counterexample_attempts: Tried: (1) External call bypass - calling onlySelfCall function directly from EOA or external contract, (2) Flag manipulation - attempting to enable selfCall without enableSelfCall modifier, (3) Reentrancy - nested enableSelfCall calls, (4) Timing attack - calling between _enableSelfCallBefore and _enableSelfCallAfter, (5) Storage collision - manipulating transient storage directly
evidence.phase3_guard_search: _onlySelfCall() at lines 36-39 implements dual condition check: (1) 'if (msg.sender != address(this)) revert OnlySelfCall()' - ensures only self-calls, (2) 'if (!SELF_CALL_STORAGE.asBoolean().tload()) revert SelfCallNotAllowed()' - ensures selfCall flag is enabled. The enableSelfCall modifier at lines 16-20 sets flag before execution, clears after.

evidence.phase3_guard_search: teleport() and singleTeleport() implement comprehensive verification: (1) Cryptographic: teleport line 325 - IWithdrawDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof(), singleTeleport line 347 - IWithdrawVerifier.verifyProof(). (2) Public inputs: lines 316-319 validate initial values = 0, final values match proof. (3) Root validation: lines 366-368 verify transferRoot matches stored provedTransferRoots or globalTransferRoots. (4) Recipient: lines 371-374 verify recipient hash matches GeneralRecipient.hash() and chainId. (5) Double-spend: lines 376-379 require value > totalTeleported[recipient], enforcing strict monotonicity.
